description: Any country's or region's economy from the World Bank's World Development Indicators (200+ countries, the euro area, the world, income groups): GDP and growth, inflation, unemployment, government debt and deficits, the current account, trade, reserves, interest rates, population and more, by plain words or indicator code, as a year-by-country table with each country's latest value.

countries.description: Countries or regions: names ("Germany", "euro area", "world") or ISO codes (US, DEU).

end.description: Last year; default this year (the latest year is often not yet published).

indicator.description: Plain words ("gdp growth", "inflation", "government debt", "current account", "unemployment") or a World Bank indicator code (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG).

start.description: First year; default ten years before end.

name: world_economy

outputSchema.description: rows are years (oldest first) with one value per country in the order of columns; latest has each country's most recent year and value.

title: World economy (World Bank)
